0.headline: Five IPOs to open next week; companies eye close to Rs 2,600 crore
0.heading: Five IPOs to open next week; companies eye close to Rs 2,600 crore
0.intro: As many as 104 companies have raised over Rs 1.4 lakh crore through IPOs in 2026 so far, suggesting continued activity in the primary market.
0.body:
Five companies, including EAAA India Alternatives, SFC Environmental Technologies, and MK Sons Fine Jewels, are set to launch their initial public offerings (IPOs) next week, seeking to raise close to Rs 2,600 crore from the primary market.

BLS Polymers and Bombay Coated and Special Steels would also float their maiden public offerings during the week.

Separately, several other companies, including Gujarat Victory Forging, Milestone Gears, Avaada Electro, Swara Baby Products, Integris Medtech and AGS Health, are in the pipeline for IPO, according to merchant bankers.

These companies are expected to announce price band declarations and launch plans by November 5, ahead of the extended Diwali holiday period in Gujarat, where markets and business activity are likely to be affected by the post-Diwali observance of Labh Pancham from November 6 to 15, they added.

The upcoming issues follow a busy month for the primary market, which saw Jio Platforms launch the country's biggest-ever public issue worth Rs 30,213 crore.

As many as 104 companies have raised over Rs 1.4 lakh crore through IPOs in 2026 so far, suggesting continued activity in the primary market.

The five upcoming IPOs will open for subscription between October 26 and October 29, offering investors exposure to sectors such as alternative investments, polymers, steel processing, wastewater treatment and jewellery retail.

These offerings are expected to keep the primary market active as companies tap investor demand to raise funds for business expansion, working capital requirements and debt repayment, while some existing shareholders seek to monetise their holdings.

EAAA India Alternatives, an arm of Edelweiss Financial Services, will open its Rs 1,200-crore IPO on October 26 and close it on October 28. The company has fixed a price band of Rs 1,585-1,665 per share, valuing it at Rs 10,765 crore at the upper end.

The issue is entirely an offer for sale (OFS) by the Edelweiss Group, meaning the company will not receive any proceeds from the offering. EAAA India Alternatives has already raised around Rs 360 crore from anchor investors ahead of the public issue.

SFC Environmental Technologies, a wastewater treatment solutions provider, will launch its Rs 668-crore IPO, with the subscription closing on October 29. The company has fixed a price band of Rs 313-330 per share, valuing it at around Rs 3,233 crore at the upper end.

The issue comprises a fresh issue of equity shares worth Rs 150 crore and an offer for sale of up to 1.57 crore shares by promoters and existing shareholders. Proceeds from the fresh issue will be used for debt repayment and working capital requirements.

MK Sons Fine Jewels Ltd will open its Rs 275.4-crore IPO on October 28 and close it on October 30. The company has fixed a price band of Rs 153-162 per share.

The IPO comprises a fresh issue of 1.36 crore equity shares and an offer for sale of 34 lakh shares by promoter selling shareholder Ramchand Murlidhar Raimalani.

The jewellery retailer plans to use the net proceeds to fund inventory requirements for setting up a new showroom in Maharashtra and expanding an existing showroom in Gujarat, besides repaying or prepaying certain borrowings and meeting general corporate expenses.

BLS Polymers Ltd will launch its Rs 255-crore IPO on October 27, with the issue closing on October 29. The company has fixed a price band of Rs 142-150 per share. The issue comprises a fresh offering of 1.7 crore equity shares.

The company plans to utilise Rs 77.56 crore from the proceeds to expand its manufacturing facility and increase production capacity, while Rs 89.5 crore will be used to meet working capital requirements. The remaining amount will be utilised for general corporate purposes.

Bombay Coated and Special Steels Ltd will open its Rs 183.1-crore IPO on October 29, with the issue closing on November 2. The company has fixed a price band of Rs 78-82 per share.

The IPO will be an entirely fresh issue of equity shares. The company plans to utilise Rs 125 crore towards repayment or prepayment of certain borrowings and Rs 15.7 crore to finance the acquisition cost of capital equipment under existing lease arrangements with Siemens Financial Services. The remaining proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.

1.headline: Abakkus, Carnelian, IIFL among 5 investors picking up 3% stake in SFC Environmental ahead of IPO
1.heading: Abakkus, Carnelian, IIFL among 5 investors picking up 3% stake in SFC Environmental ahead of IPO
1.intro: SFC Environmental Technologies IPO | The wastewater treatment solutions provider will open its public issue on October 27 and close on October 29.
1.body:
Sunil Singhania's Abakkus Asset Manager, Vikas Khemani's Carnelian, and IIFL Capital are among five investors that collectively acquired a 2.95% stake in SFC Environmental Technologies from the promoters ahead of the company’s IPO next week.

The Navi Mumbai-based wastewater treatment solutions provider will open its maiden public issue on October 27 and close on October 29.

The company aims to raise Rs 667.5 crore via initial public offering (IPO) at the upper end price band of Rs 313-330 per share. The IPO included fresh issue of Rs 150 crore along with an offer-for-sale of 1.56 crore equity shares by promoters and other selling shareholders.

Promoter Sandeep Sudhakar Asolkar (held jointly with Priya Sandeep Asolkar) and promoter entity Asolkar Tradecraft transferred 27.57 lakh equity shares, representing 2.95 percent of pre-offer paid-up equity, to five institutional investors including Abakkus Asset Manager, Carnelian Asset Management, and IIFL Capital, at Rs 330 per share, on October 22 and 23.

Abakkus Flexi Edge Fund-1, and Abakkus Growth Fund-Open Ended acquired 13.63 lakh equity shares or 1.46 percent stake for Rs 45 crore, while Carnelian Asset Management &amp; Advisors bought 6.96 lakh shares, representing 0.75 percent of pre-offer share capital worth Rs 23 crore, from Asolkar Tradecraft, on October 22.

Click Here To Read All IPO News

Further, Neo Prime Fund, and IIFL-Late Stage Private Equity Fund each purchased 3.03 lakh shares (0.32 percent stake), and Nabs Equity acquired 90,910 shares (0.1 percent stake) for Rs 3 crore on October 23. Sandeep Sudhakar Asolkar (held jointly with Priya Sandeep Asolkar) was the seller.

SFC Environmental Technologies in its notice to investors on October 24 said the shares sold by Sandeep Sudhakar Asolkar (held jointly with Priya Sandeep Asolkar) in the above-mentioned transaction do not form part of the equity shares proposed to be offered by him in the offer-for-sale.

Following these transactions, shareholding of Sandeep Sudhakar Asolkar (held jointly with Priya Sandeep Asolkar) reduced to 18.61 percent from 19.36 percent, and Asolkar Tradecraft's stake to 3.12 percent from 5.33 percent after selling shares worth Rs 91 crore.

Environmental technology company SFC Environmental offers engineering solutions in the wastewater treatment, wastewater recycling &amp; reuse, and solid waste treatment segments, which contributed 67 percent, 2 percent, and 17 percent to its revenue in FY26.

The company intends to utilise Rs 42.2 crore of proceeds from net fresh issue for repaying debt, Rs 74.9 crore for its working capital requirements, and the remaining funds for general corporate purposes, while the offer-for-sale proceeds will be received by selling shareholders.

IIFL Capital Services, JM Financial, and Nuvama Wealth Management are acting as the merchant bankers for the SFC Environmental Technologies IPO.

2.headline: EAAA India Alternatives raises Rs 360 crore via anchor book, Rs 1,200-crore IPO to open on October 26
2.heading: EAAA India Alternatives raises Rs 360 crore via anchor book, Rs 1,200-crore IPO to open on October 26
2.intro: EAAA India Alternatives IPO | The Rs 1,200-crore initial public offering will open for public subscription on October 26 with price band at Rs 1,585-1,665 per share.
2.body:
EAAA India Alternatives, the private alternative asset and investment management company-promoted by Edelweiss Group, on Friday raised Rs 360 crore by allocating 21.62 lakh equity shares via anchor book ahead of IPO opening next week.

The Rs 1,200-crore initial public offering, which comprises entirely an offer-for-sale, will open for public subscription on October 26 with price band at Rs 1,585-1,665 per share. The offer will close on October 28.

Promoter entity Edelweiss Securities and Investments will be selling shareholder in the offer-for-sale.

EAAA India Alternatives has announced allocation of 21.62 lakh shares at the upper end of price band. Global investors participated in the anchor book were Government Pension Fund Global, Schroder International, Hornbill Capital Advisors, Goldman Sachs, and BNP Paribas Financial Markets.

"Out of the total allocation to anchor book, the company allocated 14.14 lakh equity shares to 10 domestic mutual funds including HDFC AMC, SBI Mutual Fund, ICICI Prudential AMC, Nippon Life India, Kotak Mahindra AMC, Abakkus Asset Manager, HSBC Mutual Fund, and Bandhan Mutual Fund," EAAA India Alternatives in its filing to exchanges said.

As it is entirely an offer-for-sale, the issue proceeds excluding offer expenses will go to selling shareholder, and the company will not receive any funds from the public issue.

Click Here To Read All IPO News

EAAA India Alternatives mainly operates two business verticals - real assets, and private credit along with portfolio management services, managing long term patient capital with an AUM of Rs 95,344.8 crore as of June 2026.

Under the real assets business vertical, the company invests into infrastructure and commercial real estate assets through a mix of equity, quasi-equity and debt instruments, while in private credit business vertical, it provides credit and flexible financing solutions.

Axis Capital, Jefferies India, Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors, and Nuvama Wealth Management are acting as the merchant bankers for the EAAA India Alternatives IPO.
